task_description: Build a full Kenyan document-generation SaaS on Laravel 11 + MySQL + vanilla JS. Users pick a document template, fill a dynamic form, pay via M-Pesa (PayHero STK push), then download a clean PDF and Word file. Secondary features: document library stored on Telegram, OTP auth via Africa's Talking SMS, admin panel, promo codes, PWA, GitHub Actions FTP CI/CD for InfinityFree hosting.
